recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-style illustration featuring three central figures with Afro hairstyles dressed in classical Greco-Roman robes, positioned against a weathered parchment background. Above them, an ornate, multi-segmented orange banner with floral flourishes houses arched typography. The figures hold symbolic icons: a cross-staff, a heart, and an anchor, blending 1970s cultural identity with Renaissance-style allegorical painting.
coreVisualRelationships: Figures centered horizontally with the tallest in the middle
Banner arches over the figures to create a framing halo effect
Symbolic objects (cross, heart, anchor) distributed across the trio
Muted, earthy background contrasting with the saturated orange of the banner
coreInvariants: Weathered tan parchment texture across the entire canvas
Classical drapery with heavy, inked shadow lines
Ornate acanthus-style floral scrollwork behind the banner

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three full-body figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure holding the red heart acts as the focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central figure, move up to the arched banner, then sweep left and right to the flanking figures and their symbolic tools.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper corners and around the central trio to emphasize the parchment texture.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high-contrast black ink outlines and shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are warped to follow the curve and perspective of the ribbon banner
Thick vertical stems with thin horizontal serifs
White fill with thin black outlines
Variable baseline following the ribbon's movement
characterSpecificRedesigns: The ampersand is stylized and placed on a separate fold of the ribbon
Letters are condensed or expanded to fit specific ribbon segments

composition.relationshipToImage: Integrated into the graphic banner element

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary small sans-serif or typewriter font in the corners for technical metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and sharp serifs match the base skeleton.
Matches the weathered, historical feel of the illustration.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an illustration on weathered tan parchment. Three figures with Afro hairstyles in white classical robes stand in a row. The left figure holds a blue cross-staff, the center figure holds a red heart, and the right figure holds a brown anchor. Above them is an empty, ornate orange ribbon banner with floral flourishes behind it.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply white serif text with a thin black outline onto the orange banner. Warp the text to follow the curves and folds of the ribbon segments, ensuring the letters appear to be printed on the fabric of the banner.

verificationChecks: Color palette is restricted to earth tones and orange

adjustableVariables: Specific symbols held by the figures
mustRedesign: Specific faces to avoid likeness issues
Unique floral patterns in the background

mustAchieve: Hand-drawn ink quality in the shadows
Consistent lighting across all three figures
Seamless integration of text into the banner

postGenerationChecks: Does the text look like it belongs on the banner?
Are the classical robes rendered with deep ink shadows?
Is the central heart the most saturated red element?
recipe.reuseFormula: Classical Allegory + 70s Soul Aesthetic + Weathered Parchment + Arched Ribbon Typography
